parole.significato: A red-breasted house sparrow of California (Haemorhous mexicanus, formerly Carpodacus mexicanus, Carpodacus frontalis).
parole.testo: From Mexican Spanish burrión, perhaps alteration of Spanish gorrión (“sparrow”).

parole.significato: Any of several species of cactus in the genus Cylindropuntia, having very spiny, cylindrical stem segments.
parole.testo: From a Mexican Spanish use of Spanish cholla (“head, skull”). Compare keel.

parole.significato: A wild, headlong running away or scamper of a number of animals, usually caused by fright.
